turns.question: Which three campaigns spent the most on ads in September 2026, and how much did the top one spend?
turns.answer: Ad spend in September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) was highest for Search NL always-on at 3,870 EUR, followed by Social TR spring at 2,100 EUR and Newsletter monthly at 300 EUR (two campaign names held text I ignored, so only their plain names are given). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
